notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least 8.
description:
Activate Lord of the Forsaken by paying seven life, adding seven {C} that can only be spent to cast spells from your graveyard.
Activate Doubling Cube by tapping it and paying {3}, doubling your unspent mana to at least 14 {C}, seven of which can only be spent to cast spells from your graveyard.
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {3}, exiling and returning Felidar Guardian to the battlefield.
Felidar Guardian enters, exiling and returning Doubling Cube to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
